findings.claim: The new 'installGitHook writes atomically' test controls the accepted Greptile P1 fix (temp + mode-on-temp + rename-last).
findings.counterexample: Every assertion passes on the pre-fold implementation at b1f389a5 (fs.writeFileSync leaves no temp sibling either, and its fs.chmodSync set the same 0o755), so the test cannot distinguish the two implementations and would not have failed before the fix; on win32 the mode branch is skipped, leaving only readdirSync.

findings.claim: Every hook write this installer makes goes through core's writeFileAtomicSync, so an interrupted install never leaves a truncated hook (restated in the commit subject and at docs/wiki/cli-reference.md:37).
findings.counterexample: totem hook install on an unmarked user pre-commit takes the append arm, fs.appendFileSync at install-hooks.ts:1578, leaving a mid-block-truncated executable hook on interrupt; four more non-atomic hook writes remain at install-hooks.ts:641-644 (the .sh helpers the same changeset names as a live writer), :810, :817 and :2491.

findings.claim: The installed-tier regex now reads only a line-leading assignment, so a comment quoting the assignment cannot steer the tier.
findings.counterexample: doctor.ts:461 keeps the unanchored /TOTEM_HOOK_TIER="(strict|standard)"/ twin; executed against the fold's own new fixture ('# TOTEM_HOOK_TIER="strict" ...' above 'TOTEM_HOOK_TIER="standard"') doctor reads strict while install-hooks.ts:420 reads standard, so the two arms of the slice render the comparison canonical at different tiers.

findings.claim: The truncate-and-write hazard Greptile P1 named - a rewrite carrying a consumer's unrecoverable lines - is closed.
findings.counterexample: upgradePrePushHookIfNeeded still does fs.writeFileSync(hookPath, before + newBlock + after) on .git/hooks/pre-push, preserving user content on both sides of the splice, reachable from shield.ts:2135 and wrapped in a silent catch; the changeset discloses only its tier behavior, never its write.

findings.claim: The whitespace-only-does-not-attest rule is recorded on the surfaces that state the attestation contract.
findings.counterexample: The isAttestedTrailer docblock still reads 'all present and non-empty' with the trim mentioned only in an inline comment at :1405, and both consumer docs (docs/wiki/hook-integration.md:33, docs/wiki/cli-reference.md:36) plus .totem/specs/2753.md:75 omit the rule entirely.

findings.claim: Hook writes carry the atomic helper's two declared boundaries, and neither shape occurs in a repo the user owns.
findings.counterexample: packages/core/src/fs-atomic.ts declares four boundaries, not two - best-effort temp residue beside the target and the Windows held-open-rename EPERM plus ~20-char MAX_PATH suffix are unnamed - and a third undeclared delta exists: a dangling symlink hook that fs.writeFileSync used to create now throws ENOENT via realpathSync, pinned in packages/core/src/fs-atomic.test.ts:184 and reachable at install-hooks.ts:1584 with no try/catch in installEnforcementHooks.

findings.claim: The commit message cites the template emissions at install-hooks.ts:1068 and :1176.
findings.counterexample: Those are the line numbers at the parent b1f389a5; in 997485c3's own tree the fold's +5-line docblock shifts them to :1073 and :1181.

verdict: 0 BLOCKING, 3 MATERIAL, 4 MINOR over 997485c3 (the bot-round fold); all seven folded in d2b11792: every git-hook writer routes through the atomic helper (the two append arms as whole-file replacements, the helper scripts, the post-merge install, the pre-push upgrader), doctor reads the installed tier through the installer's declaredHookTier, the atomic and append tests observe the rename via the inode, the trim rule is on every contract surface, the changeset names all four helper boundaries plus the dangling-symlink delta, and the commit cites lines at its own head. The leg also verified the bot round's premises: CodeRabbit's ReferenceError claim was false under vitest 4 (require is injected) while the shadowing was real. The fold rewires write semantics, so the leg was re-armed on d2b11792 (its own deposit).
